title: ConQuR: Corner Aligned Activation Quantization via Optimized Rotations for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.10793v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are costly to deploy due to their large memory footprint and high inference cost. Weight-activation quantization can reduce these costs, but low-bit activation quantization remains difficult because activation outliers induce large quantization error. Recent rotation-based methods address this by applying orthogonal transformations that redistribute activation magnitude across dimensions, but existing approaches either require expensive end-to-end rotation training or rely on stored activation corpora, introducing significant compute or storage overhead. We propose a lightweight post-training rotation calibration method for LLM activation quantization. Our method learns orthogonal rotations that align normalized activations with the corners of an inscribed hypercube, encouraging activation energy to be distributed more evenly across dimensions. translated_title: ConQuR：基于优化旋转的大语言模型角点对齐激活量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）因其庞大的内存占用和高昂的推理成本而部署代价很高。权重-激活量化可以降低这些成本，但低比特激活量化仍然困难，因为激活异常值会引起较大的量化误差。近期的基于旋转的方法通过施加正交变换将激活幅值重新分布到各维度上来解决这一问题，但现有方法要么需要昂贵的端到端旋转训练，要么依赖存储的激活语料库，带来显著的计算或存储开销。我们提出了一种面向大语言模型激活量化的轻量级训练后旋转校准方法。该方法学习正交旋转，使归一化后的激活与内接超立方体的角点对齐，促使激活能量在各维度上更均匀地分布。该目标可通过……实现高效的闭式更新（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出轻量级训练后旋转校准方法ConQuR，通过学习正交旋转使归一化激活与内接超立方体角点对齐、让激活能量在各维度均匀分布，并以高效的闭式更新避免了昂贵的旋转训练和激活语料存储，从而实现低比特激活量化。
en_tdlr: ConQuR is a lightweight post-training rotation calibration method that learns orthogonal rotations to align normalized activations with the corners of an inscribed hypercube, evenly distributing activation energy across dimensions and enabling efficient low-bit activation quantization via closed-form updates without costly rotation training or stored activation corpora.
